title: Implement the orchestrator context, policy and the /kiln-start entry
statement: Build the persistent session behaviour: resolve and guard the content root, derive the current stage from definitions and attestations, load the matching skill, and register the start prompt that begins Stage 1 on a fresh project or summarises stage, blockers and the single recommended next action on an existing one.
notes: ⚠️ F87 (2026-09-13), TO BE FIXED BEFORE THE FIRST REAL ORCHESTRATOR SESSION. The handwritten `pi-package/skills/kiln-planning/SKILL.md` still says the typed tools 'are registered by later work' and are not implemented, and `pi-package/prompts/kiln-start.md` tells the session to say the tools are not registered and take no other action. Both have been false since TSK-0044 and TSK-0045 registered the tools. A session started with them would tell the operator the tools do not exist and then refuse to use them. ⚠️ G0 REVIEW 2026-09-13. F95: the launch allowlist is exactly Kiln's declared tools, so Pi's `read` tool is absent, and Pi's skill mechanism needs it to open a skill file; no Kiln tool returned `project.yaml` or a stage document. The orchestrator could read neither its stage skill nor the project it is about. F96: the orchestrator's handlers accept a `PLANNING_CONTENT_DIR` naming the tool's own content, and the Pi child is never told whether self-hosting was validated. F97: an operator-facing refusal naming absolute paths conflicts with the model-facing disclosure boundary. F98: a scripted provider cannot establish that a model chose a relevant question. D10: `kiln_project_status` is extended - no new tool - to return the derived current stage, its blockers, one recommended next action, the project's name and description, and the Stage 1 starter document, through the existing read-only boundary; the tool count and allowlist stay as they are. D11: a `before_agent_start` hook selects the stage skill from the derived current stage and injects the exact skill content Pi loaded, including a consumer override when Pi resolved one; Pi's `read` tool stays disabled. D12: a fresh project has no typed planning artifacts and no stage attestations; starter documents and project metadata do not make it non-fresh. D13: ACC-0071 has two surfaces - canonical absolute paths for the operator, stable placeholders and no absolute path for the model - and self-hosting needs a strict marker the launcher emits only after validating `--self-host`; absence or any malformed value refuses. D14: ACC-0068 accepts deterministic orchestration only; the user-visible first turn is ACC-0114 on TSK-0063. D15: persisting the operator's answer is ACC-0113 on TSK-0049. Out of scope here and unchanged: TSK-0049's adaptive second question, TSK-0050's approval and attestation boundary, TSK-0071's deferred stage fields, and R8, R9, F82 and F89 with their assigned tasks.
